description: This Java class 'ScalingOffsettingHelper' customizes the positioning and scaling of items within a WearableRecyclerView, causing items to shrink as they move away from the center and aligning them to the left side of the display.

classes.name: ScalingOffsettingHelper
classes.description: A helper class extending DefaultOffsettingHelper to modify child view scaling and alignment within a WearableRecyclerView, with custom shrinking behavior as items scroll away from the center.

methods.name: updateChild
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to adjust the scale of a child view based on its position relative to the center of the parent RecyclerView.
